look_here_first: Inspect opposite leaves, creeping stems and the sharp yellowish bracts on small dense flower heads.

key_traits.label: Habit
key_traits.text: Prostrate herb; creeping stems may root at nodes.

key_traits.label: Flower reproductive
key_traits.text: Ellipsoid heads with sharp straw-colored bracts.
